phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-envir.source: Your tools shape your thinking. Set them up once, set them up right.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-envir.translation: 工具会塑造你的思考方式。一次配置到位，并把它配置正确。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/02-git-and-c.source: Version control is not optional. Every experiment, every model, every lesson you build here gets tracked.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/02-git-and-c.translation: 版本控制不是可选项。你在这里完成的每个实验、每个模型和每节课程都应该留下记录。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/03-gpu-setup.source: Training on CPU is fine for learning. Training for real needs a GPU.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/03-gpu-setup.translation: 用 CPU 训练足以满足学习需要。真正进行训练时，则需要 GPU。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/04-apis-and-.source: Every AI API works the same way: send a request, get a response. The details change, the pattern doesn't.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/04-apis-and-.translation: 所有 AI API 的工作方式都一样：发送请求，接收响应。细节会变化，模式始终不变。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/05-jupyter-n.source: Notebooks are the lab bench of AI engineering. You prototype here, then move what works into production.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/05-jupyter-n.translation: Notebook 是 AI 工程的实验台。你在这里制作原型，再将可行的方案转入生产环境。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/06-python-en.source: Dependency hell is real. Virtual environments are the cure.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/06-python-en.translation: 依赖地狱确实存在，而虚拟环境就是解药。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/07-docker-fo.source: Containers make "works on my machine" a thing of the past.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/07-docker-fo.translation: 容器让“在我的机器上明明可以运行”成为过去式。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/08-editor-se.source: Your editor is your co-pilot. Configure it once so it stays out of your way and starts pulling its weight.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/08-editor-se.translation: 编辑器是你的副驾驶。一次配置妥当，让它不再妨碍你，并真正开始发挥作用。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/09-data-mana.source: Data is the fuel. How you manage it determines how fast you go.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/09-data-mana.translation: 数据是燃料。管理数据的方式决定了你能前进多快。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/10-terminal-.source: The terminal is where AI engineers live. Get comfortable here.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/10-terminal-.translation: 终端是 AI 工程师工作的主场。请熟练掌握它。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/11-linux-for.source: Most AI runs on Linux. You need to know enough to not be stuck.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/11-linux-for.translation: 大多数 AI 工作负载都运行在 Linux 上。你至少要掌握足够的知识，确保自己不会被卡住。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/12-debugging.source: The worst AI bugs don't crash. They train silently on garbage and report a beautiful loss curve.
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/12-debugging.translation: 最糟糕的 AI 缺陷不会让程序崩溃，而是悄无声息地用垃圾数据训练，最后给你一条漂亮的损失曲线。

phases/01-math-foundations/01-linear-alg.source: Every AI model is just matrix math wearing a fancy hat.
phases/01-math-foundations/01-linear-alg.translation: 每个 AI 模型，本质上都只是戴了一顶华丽帽子的矩阵运算。

phases/01-math-foundations/02-vectors-ma.source: Every neural network is just matrix multiplication with extra steps.
phases/01-math-foundations/02-vectors-ma.translation: 每个神经网络，本质上都只是多了几道步骤的矩阵乘法。

phases/01-math-foundations/03-matrix-tra.source: A matrix is a machine that reshapes space. Learn what it does to every point, and you understand the whole transformation.
phases/01-math-foundations/03-matrix-tra.translation: 矩阵是一台重塑空间的机器。理解它如何作用于每一个点，你就理解了整个变换。

phases/01-math-foundations/04-calculus-f.source: Derivatives tell you which way is downhill. That is all a neural network needs to learn.
phases/01-math-foundations/04-calculus-f.translation: 导数告诉你下坡的方向。神经网络学习所需的，不过如此。

phases/01-math-foundations/05-chain-rule.source: The chain rule is the engine behind every neural network that learns.
phases/01-math-foundations/05-chain-rule.translation: 链式法则是每个能够学习的神经网络背后的引擎。

phases/01-math-foundations/06-probabilit.source: Probability is the language AI uses to express uncertainty.
phases/01-math-foundations/06-probabilit.translation: 概率是 AI 用来表达不确定性的语言。

phases/01-math-foundations/07-bayes-theo.source: Probability is about what you expect. Bayes' theorem is about what you learn.
phases/01-math-foundations/07-bayes-theo.translation: 概率描述你的预期，Bayes 定理描述你如何根据证据学习。

phases/01-math-foundations/08-optimizati.source: Training a neural network is nothing more than finding the bottom of a valley.
phases/01-math-foundations/08-optimizati.translation: 训练神经网络，不过是在寻找山谷的最低点。

phases/01-math-foundations/09-informatio.source: Information theory measures surprise. Loss functions are built on it.
phases/01-math-foundations/09-informatio.translation: 信息论衡量意外程度，损失函数就建立在它之上。

phases/01-math-foundations/10-dimensiona.source: High-dimensional data has structure. You find it by looking from the right angle.
phases/01-math-foundations/10-dimensiona.translation: 高维数据自有其结构。你需要从正确的角度观察，才能发现它。

phases/01-math-foundations/11-singular-v.source: SVD is the Swiss Army knife of linear algebra. Every matrix has one. Every data scientist needs one.
phases/01-math-foundations/11-singular-v.translation: SVD 是线性代数中的瑞士军刀。每个矩阵都有 SVD，每位数据科学家都需要掌握它。

phases/01-math-foundations/12-tensor-ope.source: Tensors are the common language between data and deep learning. Every image, every sentence, every gradient flows through them.
phases/01-math-foundations/12-tensor-ope.translation: 张量是数据与深度学习之间的通用语言。每张图像、每个句子和每份梯度都会流经张量。

phases/01-math-foundations/13-numerical-.source: Floating point is a leaky abstraction. It will bite you during training, and you will not see it coming.
phases/01-math-foundations/13-numerical-.translation: 浮点数是一种会泄漏细节的抽象。它会在训练过程中反噬你，而且往往毫无征兆。

phases/01-math-foundations/14-norms-and-.source: Your distance function defines what "similar" means. Choose wrong and everything downstream breaks.
phases/01-math-foundations/14-norms-and-.translation: 距离函数定义了“相似”的含义。选错了，后续所有环节都会出问题。

phases/01-math-foundations/15-statistics.source: Statistics is how you know if your model actually works or just got lucky.
phases/01-math-foundations/15-statistics.translation: 统计学帮助你判断模型是真的有效，还是仅仅运气好。

phases/01-math-foundations/16-sampling-m.source: Sampling is how AI explores the space of possibilities.
phases/01-math-foundations/16-sampling-m.translation: 采样是 AI 探索可能性空间的方式。

phases/01-math-foundations/17-linear-sys.source: Solving Ax = b is the oldest problem in mathematics that still runs your neural network.
phases/01-math-foundations/17-linear-sys.translation: 求解 Ax = b 是数学中最古老的问题之一，却至今仍在驱动你的神经网络。

phases/01-math-foundations/18-convex-opt.source: Convex problems have one valley. Neural networks have millions. Knowing the difference matters.
phases/01-math-foundations/18-convex-opt.translation: 凸问题只有一个山谷，神经网络却有数百万个。理解二者的区别十分重要。

phases/01-math-foundations/19-complex-nu.source: The square root of -1 is not imaginary. It is the key to rotations, frequencies, and half of signal processing.
phases/01-math-foundations/19-complex-nu.translation: -1 的平方根并非虚幻之物，而是旋转、频率以及半个信号处理领域的关键。

phases/01-math-foundations/20-fourier-tr.source: Every signal is a sum of sine waves. The Fourier transform tells you which ones.
phases/01-math-foundations/20-fourier-tr.translation: 每个信号都是若干正弦波之和，Fourier 变换会告诉你其中有哪些波。

phases/01-math-foundations/21-graph-theo.source: Graphs are the data structure of relationships. If your data has connections, you need graph theory.
phases/01-math-foundations/21-graph-theo.translation: 图是表达关系的数据结构。只要数据中存在连接，就需要图论。

phases/01-math-foundations/22-stochastic.source: Randomness with structure. The math behind random walks, Markov chains, and diffusion models.
phases/01-math-foundations/22-stochastic.translation: 具有结构的随机性：随机游走、Markov 链和扩散模型背后的数学。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/01-what-is-mac.source: Machine learning is teaching computers to find patterns in data instead of writing rules by hand.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/01-what-is-mac.translation: 机器学习不是手工编写规则，而是教计算机从数据中发现模式。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/02-linear-regr.source: Linear regression draws the best straight line through your data. It is the "hello world" of machine learning.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/02-linear-regr.translation: 线性回归会在数据中画出最佳直线，是机器学习的“Hello, world”。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/03-logistic-re.source: Logistic regression bends a straight line into an S-curve to answer yes-or-no questions with probabilities.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/03-logistic-re.translation: 逻辑回归把直线弯成 S 形曲线，用概率回答“是或否”的问题。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/04-decision-tr.source: A decision tree is just a flowchart. But a forest of them is one of the most powerful tools in ML.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/04-decision-tr.translation: 决策树不过是一张流程图，但由许多树组成的森林，却是机器学习中最强大的工具之一。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/05-support-vec.source: Find the widest street between two classes. That is the entire idea.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/05-support-vec.translation: 在两个类别之间找出最宽间隔，这就是支持向量机的核心思想。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/06-knn-and-dis.source: Store everything. Predict by looking at your neighbors. The simplest algorithm that actually works.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/06-knn-and-dis.translation: 保存所有数据，通过观察邻居进行预测。这是最简单、却真正有效的算法。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/07-unsupervise.source: No labels, no teacher. The algorithm finds structure on its own.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/07-unsupervise.translation: 没有标签，也没有老师，算法自行发现结构。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/08-feature-eng.source: A good feature is worth a thousand data points.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/08-feature-eng.translation: 一个好特征胜过一千个数据点。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/09-model-evalu.source: A model is only as good as the way you measure it.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/09-model-evalu.translation: 模型好不好，取决于你如何衡量它。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/10-bias-varian.source: Every model error comes from one of three sources: bias, variance, or noise. You can only control the first two.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/10-bias-varian.translation: 模型误差只来自三个来源：偏差、方差或噪声，而你只能控制前两者。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/11-ensemble-me.source: A group of weak learners, combined correctly, becomes a strong learner. This is not a metaphor. It is a theorem.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/11-ensemble-me.translation: 一组弱学习器只要组合得当，就能成为强学习器。这并非比喻，而是一个定理。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/12-hyperparame.source: Hyperparameters are the knobs you turn before training starts. Turning them well is the difference between a mediocre model and a great one.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/12-hyperparame.translation: 超参数是在训练开始前由你调节的旋钮。能否把它们调好，决定了最终得到的是一个平庸模型，还是一个优秀模型。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/13-ml-pipeline.source: A model is not a product. A pipeline is. The pipeline is everything from raw data to deployed prediction, and every step must be reproducible.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/13-ml-pipeline.translation: 模型本身不是产品，流水线才是。流水线涵盖从原始数据到部署后预测的全部过程，而且每个步骤都必须可复现。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/14-naive-bayes.source: The "naive" assumption is wrong, and it works anyway. That's the beauty of it.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/14-naive-bayes.translation: “朴素”的假设明明不成立，算法却依然有效。这正是它的精妙之处。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/15-time-series.source: Past performance does predict future results -- if you check for stationarity first.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/15-time-series.translation: 过去的表现的确可以预测未来的结果——前提是你先检查平稳性。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/16-anomaly-det.source: Normal is easy to define. Abnormal is whatever doesn't fit.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/16-anomaly-det.translation: 正常很容易定义，不符合正常模式的就是异常。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/17-imbalanced-.source: When 99% of your data is "normal," accuracy is a lie.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/17-imbalanced-.translation: 当 99% 的数据都属于“正常”类别时，准确率就是一个谎言。

phases/02-ml-fundamentals/18-feature-sel.source: More features is not better. The right features is better.
phases/02-ml-fundamentals/18-feature-sel.translation: 特征并非越多越好，选对特征才更好。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/01-the-perc.source: The perceptron is the atom of neural networks. Split it open and you find weights, a bias, and a decision.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/01-the-perc.translation: 感知机是神经网络的原子。把它拆开来看，里面只有权重、偏置和一次决策。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/02-multi-la.source: One neuron draws a line. Stack them, and you can draw anything.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/02-multi-la.translation: 一个神经元只能画出一条直线。把它们堆叠起来，就能画出任何形状。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/03-backprop.source: Backpropagation is the algorithm that makes learning possible. Without it, neural networks are just expensive random number generators.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/03-backprop.translation: 反向传播是让学习成为可能的算法。没有它，神经网络只是一台昂贵的随机数生成器。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/04-activati.source: Without nonlinearity, your 100-layer network is a fancy matrix multiply. Activations are the gates that let neural networks think in curves.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/04-activati.translation: 没有非线性，100 层网络也不过是一次华丽的矩阵乘法。激活函数打开了一扇门，让神经网络得以用曲线思考。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/05-loss-fun.source: Your network makes a prediction. The ground truth says otherwise. How wrong is it? That number is the loss. Pick the wrong loss function and your model optimizes for the wrong t…
phases/03-deep-learning-core/05-loss-fun.translation: 网络给出一个预测，真实答案却并非如此。它错得有多离谱？这个数值就是损失。选错损失函数，模型就会优化一个完全错误的目标。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/06-optimize.source: Gradient descent tells you which direction to move. It says nothing about how far or how fast. SGD is a compass. Adam is GPS with traffic data.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/06-optimize.translation: 梯度下降告诉你应该朝哪个方向移动，却没有说明应该走多远、走多快。SGD 像指南针，Adam 则像掌握实时路况的 GPS。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/07-regulari.source: Your model gets 99% on training data and 60% on test data. It memorized instead of learning. Regularization is the tax you impose on complexity to force generalization.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/07-regulari.translation: 模型在训练数据上达到 99%，在测试数据上却只有 60%。它记住了数据，而非学会了规律。正则化就是向复杂度征税，迫使模型具备泛化能力。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/08-weight-i.source: Initialize wrong and training never starts. Initialize right and 50 layers train as smoothly as 3.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/08-weight-i.translation: 初始化错误，训练根本不会开始；初始化正确，50 层网络也能像 3 层网络一样平稳训练。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/09-learning.source: The learning rate is the single most important hyperparameter. Not the architecture. Not the dataset size. Not the activation function. The learning rate. If you tune nothing el…
phases/03-deep-learning-core/09-learning.translation: 学习率是最重要的单个超参数。不是架构，不是数据集大小，也不是激活函数，而是学习率。如果只调一个参数，就调它。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/10-mini-fra.source: You have built neurons, layers, networks, backprop, activations, loss functions, optimizers, regularization, initialization, and LR schedules. All as separate pieces. Now wire t…
phases/03-deep-learning-core/10-mini-fra.translation: 你已经分别构建了神经元、层、网络、反向传播、激活函数、损失函数、优化器、正则化、初始化和学习率调度。现在把它们连接成一个框架。不是 PyTorch，也不是 TensorFlow，而是属于你自己的框架。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/11-intro-to.source: You built the engine from pistons and crankshafts. Now learn the one everyone actually drives.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/11-intro-to.translation: 你已经从活塞和曲轴开始造出了引擎。现在来学习所有人真正使用的那一款。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/12-intro-to.source: PyTorch mutates tensors. TensorFlow builds graphs. JAX compiles pure functions. That last one changes how you think about deep learning.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/12-intro-to.translation: PyTorch 会修改张量，TensorFlow 会构建计算图，JAX 则会编译纯函数。最后这一点会改变你思考深度学习的方式。

phases/03-deep-learning-core/13-debuggin.source: Your network compiled. It ran. It produced a number. The number is wrong and nothing crashed. Welcome to the hardest kind of debugging -- the kind where there is no error message.
phases/03-deep-learning-core/13-debuggin.translation: 网络编译成功，也运行完毕，还输出了一个数值。但这个数值是错的，程序却没有崩溃。欢迎来到最棘手的调试领域——这里根本没有错误消息。

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-envir.source: Diagnose and fix AI engineering environment setup issues
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/01-dev-envir.translation: 诊断并修复 AI 工程环境配置问题

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/04-apis-and-.source: Diagnose and fix common AI API errors (auth, rate limits, timeouts)
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/04-apis-and-.translation: 诊断并修复常见的 AI API 错误（身份认证、速率限制、超时）

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/05-jupyter-n.source: Debug Jupyter notebook issues including kernel crashes, memory problems, and display failures
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/05-jupyter-n.translation: 调试 Jupyter Notebook 问题，包括 kernel 崩溃、内存问题和显示故障

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/09-data-mana.source: Find and load the right dataset for an AI/ML task
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/09-data-mana.translation: 为 AI/ML 任务查找并加载合适的数据集

phases/00-setup-and-tooling/12-debugging.source: Diagnose AI-specific bugs including NaN loss, shape errors, training failures, and OOM
phases/00-setup-and-tooling/12-debugging.translation: 诊断 AI 特有的缺陷，包括 loss 为 NaN、shape 错误、训练失败和 OOM

phases/01-math-foundations/01-linear-alg.source: Teach linear algebra through geometric intuition and AI applications
phases/01-math-foundations/01-linear-alg.translation: 通过几何直觉和 AI 应用讲解线性代数

phases/01-math-foundations/02-vectors-ma.source: Teaches matrix operations through geometric intuition, connecting abstract math to neural network mechanics
phases/01-math-foundations/02-vectors-ma.translation: 通过几何直觉讲解矩阵运算，将抽象数学与神经网络的运行机制联系起来

phases/01-math-foundations/03-matrix-tra.source: Explain what a matrix transformation does geometrically given its entries
phases/01-math-foundations/03-matrix-tra.translation: 根据矩阵元素，从几何角度解释矩阵变换的作用

phases/01-math-foundations/04-calculus-f.source: Compute gradients of common ML loss functions and choose the right derivative approach
phases/01-math-foundations/04-calculus-f.translation: 计算常见 ML 损失函数的梯度，并选择合适的求导方法

phases/01-math-foundations/05-chain-rule.source: Build, debug, and reason about automatic differentiation systems
phases/01-math-foundations/05-chain-rule.translation: 构建、调试并推理自动微分系统

phases/01-math-foundations/06-probabilit.source: Choose the right probability distribution for a given ML problem
phases/01-math-foundations/06-probabilit.translation: 为给定 ML 问题选择合适的概率分布

phases/01-math-foundations/07-bayes-theo.source: Walk through Bayesian reasoning step by step for any scenario
phases/01-math-foundations/07-bayes-theo.translation: 针对任意场景逐步推演贝叶斯推理

phases/01-math-foundations/08-optimizati.source: Guides the user through choosing the right optimizer for their specific machine learning problem
phases/01-math-foundations/08-optimizati.translation: 引导用户为具体的机器学习问题选择合适的优化器

phases/01-math-foundations/09-informatio.source: Apply information theory concepts to ML loss functions, model evaluation, and feature selection
phases/01-math-foundations/09-informatio.translation: 将信息论概念应用于 ML 损失函数、模型评估和特征选择
